runtime_changes: Two production release-label strings only; gameplay interventions remain in isolated diagnostic copies.
sampling: Every 37th simulation tic, coprime with 4/8/35-tic gameplay cadences; costs include probe overhead.
denominator: Sum of exclusive measured scopes per sampled tic, not total process CPU or wall time.
limitations: Native thinker rows are individual sampled tics.
Render CPU timers overlap worker activity and do not isolate GPU execution.
Overlay callbacks are not physical presentation or input latency.
Diagnostic formation and shared perception change workloads; deltas are not additive causal shares.
